description: On the fixed single virtual output, the horizontal dock panel is centered within the output-width dock surface.

assertions.comment: This is an invariant on the fixed single output: I see the dock surface use the full 1024px output width. A second virtual output with different geometry would be required to make recentering causal.
This is an invariant on the fixed single output: I see the panel remain 220px wide. A second virtual output with different geometry would be required to cause and verify a new centered position.
This is an invariant on the fixed single output: I see the panel centered at (1024-220)/2=402. A second virtual output with different geometry would be required to make this recentering causal.

This is an invariant on the fixed single output: I see the 204px icon row centered at x=8 in the 220px panel. A second virtual output with different geometry would be required to cause a new centering calculation.
